domain_description: Genealogy research, DNA analysis, historical records interpretation, property lineage tracing, and family trust analysis. Specialized in McWilliams dynasty research, Texas vital statistics, county deed records, and multigenerational estate planning using GEDCOM standards, genetic genealogy methods, and archival research techniques.
authority_sources: Board for Certification of Genealogists (BCG Standards)

engines.name: Genealogy Research Engine
engines.function: Conduct systematic genealogical research using primary and derivative sources, evaluate evidence quality, resolve conflicting records, construct family group sheets, and maintain research logs per BCG standards and the Genealogical Proof Standard.
doctrine_topics: GEDCOM file structure and data exchange
research log methodology and citation format

golden_queries.question: Construct a research plan to identify the parents of a John McWilliams born circa 1850 in East Texas, with only a marriage record (1872, Smith County) and 1880 census entry as starting evidence.
required_elements: research plan with prioritized record types

golden_queries.question: Evaluate conflicting evidence: a death certificate lists the decedent's mother as Mary Jones, but a Bible record says Mary Johnson, and the 1900 census shows Mary J. Determine the most probable correct name using the Genealogical Proof Standard.

engines.name: DNA Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze genetic genealogy results including autosomal DNA, Y-DNA, mtDNA, and X-DNA inheritance patterns, segment analysis, ethnicity estimates, and DNA match clustering for relationship prediction.
doctrine_topics: shared cM to relationship prediction tables
Y-DNA haplogroup analysis and surname projects
DNA match clustering Leeds method and beyond

golden_queries.question: A DNA match shares 850 cM across 35 segments. Both individuals have deep Texas roots. Determine the most likely relationships, design a testing strategy to narrow possibilities, and address potential endogamy effects.
required_elements: segment analysis large vs small segments

engines.name: Historical Records Engine
engines.function: Analyze historical documents including land grants, military records, probate files, census enumerations, tax rolls, and newspaper archives for genealogical and property lineage research with paleographic skills.
doctrine_topics: Texas Republic and early statehood land grants
Confederate and Union military service records
Texas ad valorem tax rolls as evidence

golden_queries.question: Trace a Texas family through the 1850, 1860, 1870, and 1880 census records, identifying family members, property values, occupation changes, and migration patterns through the Civil War period. The family appears in Harrison County in 1850 and Midland County by 1880.

engines.name: Property Lineage Engine
engines.function: Trace property ownership chains through deed records, mineral conveyances, partition actions, tax sales, and adverse possession claims, linking property transfers to family lineage events like death, marriage, and inheritance.
doctrine_topics: deed record chain of title construction
tax sale and redemption record analysis
property transfer at death intestate succession
oil and gas lease lineage tracing
surface vs mineral estate separation history

golden_queries.question: A 640-acre section in Reeves County was patented in 1905 by J.W. McWilliams. Construct the complete property lineage through present day, identifying all mineral interest conveyances, heir determinations, and current fractional ownership.

engines.name: Family Trust Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze family trust structures, dynasty trust provisions, generation-skipping transfer tax implications, trustee duties, beneficiary rights, and multigenerational wealth transfer strategies under Texas Estates Code and Internal Revenue Code.
doctrine_topics: dynasty trust perpetuities and Texas law
trust income taxation grantor vs non-grantor
special needs trust and supplemental needs trust
family limited partnership integration with trusts
trust decanting and modification under Texas law

golden_queries.question: Design a multigenerational wealth transfer structure for a Texas family with $50M in oil and gas mineral interests, 3 children, and 8 grandchildren. Address estate tax, GST tax, mineral management, and dynasty trust options under Texas law.
required_elements: dynasty trust structure under Texas rule against perpetuities
estate tax reduction through gift/trust planning
